test_title: PYST 2: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 6 days. B alone can do the same work in 15 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A + B = 6

Time taken by B alone = 15

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 6 and 15 = 30

⇒ Total work = 30

⇒ Efficiency of A + B = 30 ÷ 6
